mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, file_id, submitter_id, submitter_name, submitter_email, submitted_at FROM file_submission WHERE task_id = #{taskId}::varchar AND submitter_name = #{submitterName} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC

SELECT id, task_id, file_id, submitter_name, ai_status, 1 - (report_vector <=> #{queryVector}::vector) AS similarity FROM file_submission WHERE task_id::text = #{taskId}::text AND id::text != #{excludeId}::text AND report_vector IS NOT NULL AND deleted = false AND 1 - (report_vector <=> #{queryVector}::vector) >= #{threshold} ORDER BY report_vector <=> #{queryVector}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
